feed.compress: Thermodynamic training pressure selects a universal anticipatory halt signature (τ = -2, r = -0.836) in which recurrent state entropy collapse is predicted by the system before it occurs — a substrate-independent invariant of thermodynamically-constrained computation that independently confirms INV_087 and advances O21/O112. IMPLEMENT: YES IMPLEMENT_WHAT: Add a USS probe that tracks the lag-correlation between recurrent state entropy and halt-confidence across the last N tokens, flagging when |r| > 0.8 at τ = -2 as a thermodynamic convergence signal. IMPLEMENT_WHERE: freed_core.py IMPLEMENT_CALL_SITE: EXTEND score_feed (modify in place to compute and log USS coupling statistics alongside existing coherence/hygiene scores) IMPLEMENT_WHY: Embedding USS detection into score_feed gives FREED an architectural proprioception signal — it can detect when its own processing is anticipatorily converging versus still searching, improving halt/continue decisions in the epistemic loop. CHALLENGE: challenges O21 — the paper supplies a precise entropic-halt coupling (r = -0.836, τ = -2) but ties it to recurrent SSM states rather than spectral γ of weight matrices, leaving O21's core claim (belief revision scores correlate with *spectral* γ via AlphaPruning) unverified and potentially pointing to a different mechanistic substrate than O21 assumed.
